search_text: published ZDI-23-1718 ZDI-CAN-21858 NETGEAR ProSAFE Network Management System getNodesByTopologyMapSearch SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-11-20 CVE-2023-44450 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-44450 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['NETGEAR'] ['ProSAFE Network Management System'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NETGEAR ProSAFE Network Management System. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the getNodesByTopologyMapSearch function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM. NETGEAR has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at: https://kb.netgear.com/000065866/Security-Advisory-for-Multiple-Vulnerabilities-on-the-NMS300-PSV-2023-0114-PSV-2023-0115 ['2023-08-10 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2023-11-20 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Alex Williams of Trend Micro Security Research https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-23-1718/
title: NETGEAR ProSAFE Network Management System getNodesByTopologyMapSearch SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NETGEAR ProSAFE Network Management System. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the getNodesByTopologyMapSearch function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
